overview: Using the Internet and global satellites, a group of gangsters pull off the biggest bank heist in the Mafia's history.

recs.blurb: A gang of criminals and corrupt cops plan the murder of a police officer in order to pull off their biggest heist yet across town.
Based on the true story of Jack DiNorscio, a mobster who defended himself in court for what would be the longest mafia trial in U.S. history.
A friendship is formed between an ex-gangster, and two groups of hitmen - those who want to protect him and those who were sent to kill him.
